description: The sign lists Venusaurite at 10,000, finite stock one. Use +store, Buy items, then Venusaurite 1. Check +inventory and +itemdex Venusaurite; equip with +hold <party slot>=Venusaurite outside battle. A native Venusaur can reserve +mega before its ordinary +attack; doubles require your actor slot. One reusable Mega use per side per battle, with no ring, quest, fee or bag debit. Return the stone with +hold <party slot>= after battle. Other stone pairs remain deferred. The back exit returns to the selected public hub. No automatic refill or resale.
